cancellationTerms: If the user cancels the appointment at least 120 minutes (2 hours) before the agreed time for the service, they will receive a full refund in the form of a coupon via the ZETABARBER app. This coupon can be used for future bookings with the same merchant. If the cancellation occurs less than 2 hours before, no refund will be possible and the merchant reserves the right to withhold the entire amount paid to compensate for the non-provision of the service.
paymentTerms: The online payment service of ZETABARBER SRL is provided by a third-party payment service provider (PSP) which is currently HIPAY. In order to use the online payment service, in addition to accepting these Terms and Conditions of ZETABARBER SRL, the Customer must accept the Terms of Service of the PSP (PSP ToS). By using the online payment service, the Customer confirms: (a) that they have downloaded or printed the PSP ToS, and (b) that they have reviewed and accepted them. The PSP ToS are the terms of the PSP and are not the terms of ZETABARBER SRL. ZETABARBER SRL does not provide any warranty or assurance regarding the adequacy or relevance of the PSP ToS for the Customer, and the Customer should review them carefully. When a Customer pays the Merchant User for their online services, the payment is processed by the PSP. ZETABARBER SRL does not handle funds at any time, and therefore assumes no responsibility for the transfer of money or any issues that may arise. The Customer is fully responsible for keeping their information up to date with the PSP. The PSP will apply a transaction fee to each transaction. The fee is deducted at the time of the periodic return of the collected amounts; therefore, the Merchant User will receive the price of the service minus the relevant fees.
